film: How Old Is the Earth? Three clocks that had to be broken
reviewer: axiom — the producer itself. NO human watched, listened to or approved this film, and none is claimed.

what_was_actually_inspected.every_shot_two_moments: tools/smoke_scenes.py rendered 2 frames per shot at 0.35 scale for all 77 shots (154 frames) after every code change; 8 contact sheets opened - work/smoke/
what_was_actually_inspected.full_resolution_stills: 1080p stills rendered straight from the timeline for 22 named shots across the film (work/probe, work/review/r02..p7) and opened
what_was_actually_inspected.moving_picture: the finished 720p cut was sampled every 5 s end to end (189 frames, 7 contact sheets) and every sheet was opened and read
what_was_actually_inspected.start_and_end: chapter 1 opening 0-20 s, and the final 25 s at 5 s intervals were read frame by frame in the sheets

measurement_not_impression.activity: rendered frames at 1 s steps compared by mean absolute pixel difference
measurement_not_impression.density: per-shot content coverage of the frame against the modal background value

what_was_actually_inspected.final_file_sampling: the DELIVERED master (final/axiom-r01-1080p.mp4) was decoded with FFmpeg every 15 s for its entire 944.917 s (63 frames, 2 contact sheets, both opened) and read chapter by chapter

final_file_numbers.coverage_note: sampling every 15 s cannot certify motion quality or audio; motion is judged from measured frame differences (tools/holdcheck.py) and audio from measured loudness/peak. No human listened to or watched this film.

measured_activity.method: rendered frames at 1.00s steps at 0.25 scale, compared by mean absolute pixel difference; action >= 1.60, hold < 0.55 (0-255 grey levels)

audio.measured_on: the exact WAV that is muxed into the master

revisions_made_because_of_this_review: pass 1: 26 code changes - moustache/mouth collision on every bearded face, horseshoe beard shape, solid Siccar outcrop instead of floating bars, canyon+ruler for the abyss beat, math face for the chalkboard formula (it had been a tofu box), flooding waterline, real events on the count_back axis, caption/prop collisions in 15 shots, opaque credit card, milder end fade
pass 2: rebuilt the three thinnest informational beats found by measured density (Perry 1895, two_clocks, whole_system), clarified a caption that could be misread as a sequence
pass 2b: automatic glyph-coverage detection (the display face silently drew the arrow as an empty box), real arrowheads, becquerel/two_clocks layout collisions
final check: true peak measured -0.79 dBTP on the first mux (AAC overshoot) - re-normalised the delivery audio by -0.9 dB and re-muxed, giving -1.84 dBTP and a clean gate
known_remaining_weaknesses: Figures are deliberately simple: hands are mitten-ellipses and limbs are single strokes; faces carry the acting.
Some scenes are stills with type reveals rather than continuous motion; motion lives in reveals, characters and camera moves.
The score is synthesized and deliberately plain; it is not a produced soundtrack with live players.
Every claim is sourced, but the film is narrated by a synthetic voice; there is no presenter on camera.
A human viewer may disagree with the pacing judgement; the numbers here show no hold longer than 3 s and a median action interval of 1.24 s, which is the evidence offered.
Publication to storagecode is blocked: no credentials and no .git metadata survived the sandbox reset. Assets are hashed and the exact command is in final/axiom-r01-RELEASE-MANIFEST.json.

self_score.note: Scored by the producer against the brief's criteria; evidence pointers are in the accompanying technical and activity files.

technical_correctness.evidence: 1920x1080 h264/yuv420p, 24 fps, AAC 48 kHz 191 kbps, A/V drift 0.021 s, no frozen or silent tail, loudness -15.4 LUFS / -1.3 dBTP

narrative_and_script.evidence: 10 chapters, 2364 spoken words, four-clocks spine with a reversal in each act, self-correcting cues 2.7 and 6.8/6.9

visual_craft.evidence: 77 shots, 76 distinct scenes, 8 background presets, 14 dressed rooms, 20 on-screen reveals per minute; weakest across the film are the plainest diagram-only beats

sourcing_honesty.evidence: research/sources.md: 14 institutional/peer-reviewed sources plus 6 sources for the objections; every factual cue mapped in evidence/source-rights.md; the popular 'radioactivity saved Kelvin' story is explicitly contradicted; the Rutherford anecdote is labelled

process_and_reproducibility.evidence: all code, cue text and scene data in the agent tree; timeline and score rebuild from the measured narration; tools for smoke testing, activity measurement, subtitles and packaging

self_score.verdict: Meets the brief's technical and structural requirements; the remaining gap is artistic, not mechanical.
